coverage._why: A sensor only receives a quake's alert if it lies inside that quake's alert radius. Allen et al. 2025 (Zenodo 15498729, docs/findings.md finding 5): M4.5 reaches 31 km, M5.0 reaches 78 km. So a phone within 31 km of its sensor is covered from M4.5 up, within 78 km only from M5.0 up, and beyond that not at all.
